stage.note: No traditional pre-seed/seed/Series-A-D venture financing history found. The company (originally Luminati Networks, a division of Hola VPN) was spun out and majority-acquired by London private-equity fund EMK Capital in 2017 at a ~$200M valuation; it has been profitable/bootstrapped-style since and is not known to have raised further priced VC rounds. 'unknown' is used because none of the listed VC stages cleanly apply to a PE buyout of a bootstrapped division.

revenue.quote: Bright Data CEO Or Lenchner announced on April 6 that the company has surpassed $300M in annual recurring revenue and is growing over 40% year-over-year.

note: Bright Data (this card covers its Browser API / Scraping Browser product) began life in 2014 as Luminati Networks, a division of the Hola VPN company, monetizing Hola's free-VPN userbase as proxy exit nodes. In 2017 a London private-equity fund, EMK Capital, acquired a majority stake at a reported ~$200M valuation; the company was renamed Bright Data in March 2021. It is not independent, not VC-staged, and not a subsidiary of a big tech company — it is a PE-backed, profitable data-collection/proxy company with no known accelerator affiliation. It has faced and won major litigation (Meta, X/Twitter) over web scraping practices, which is relevant risk context for buyers. Revenue ($300M ARR, +40% YoY) is a CEO public statement relayed by a third-party aggregator, not a primary filing.
